# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- When updating Form2 UI, use the user's provided narrow 60-pixel sidebar design with 44-pixel vertical tabs, sampled red/gold/green gradients, and rotated labels.

## Database Management
- For the database archive feature, use the simple table name `Archive` instead of `ProductArchive`.

## Code Maintenance
- For cleanup and documentation, remove duplicate or unused code only after checking references.
- Label OOP comments explicitly on parent and child classes, including which class is the parent and which is the child.
